items.title: Daily Briefing
items.script: Here is your daily briefing. The Pentagon has conditionally approved a $250 million loan to help 6K expand its battery production. This article discusses how reverse game theory might help manage powerful AI systems by creating incentives for cooperation. Anthropic is set to become the first AI-focused company to go public as public trust in AI declines. Berkshire Hathaway increased its share repurchases by more than double in the third quarter. This happened even though the company's operating and overall profits decreased.
